articles.summary: GREENWICH, Conn., Sept. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- XPO (NYSE: XPO) will hold its third quarter conference call and webcast on Thursday, October 29, at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. The company's results will be released earlier that morning and made available on www.xpo.com.
